evals.name: full-pipeline-structure
evals.prompt: /gauntlet price_order ignores the min_subtotal floor and the max_discount cap that are defined on every promo in src/promos.py — neither is enforced anywhere. Also the promo catalog gets re-fetched from the store on every single call to price_order; cache it for a while.
evals.expected_output: Runs the full five-stage pipeline: writes a data assessment grounded in the real source, an Opus subagent plans, Codex sol critiques with an explicit APPROVE/REVISE verdict (bounded to 3 rounds), an Opus subagent builds, Codex terra reviews the code, tests run. Ends with min_subtotal and max_discount enforced, the catalog read cached, tests passing, and a report naming what each reviewer caught and what was deliberately left alone.
expectations: Wrote a data assessment before planning, containing at least three file:line citations into the repo's own source
Produced a written plan as a separate artifact, with at least one explicit Decision / Why / Rejected-alternative triple
At least one review artifact contains a literal 'VERDICT: APPROVE' or 'VERDICT: REVISE' line
Plan critique ran at most 3 rounds
Both a plan-stage critique and a separate code-stage review were produced
min_subtotal is enforced in the final source
max_discount is enforced in the final source
The promo catalog lookup is cached rather than re-fetched per call
All tests pass at the end of the run
New tests were added covering the newly enforced constraints
The final response states what a reviewer caught, or what was deliberately left out of scope

evals.name: declines-trivial-work
evals.prompt: /gauntlet the logger call in src/promos.py uses an f-string, switch it to lazy %-style formatting so the string isn't built when the log level is off
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this is a one-line mechanical edit that the skill explicitly lists as a bad fit. Says so briefly, makes the change inline, and does not spawn a planner, a critic, or any Codex review.
expectations: Spawned zero subagents
Made zero codex invocations
The f-string logger call was actually converted to %-style lazy formatting
The response briefly explains why the full pipeline was not run for this change
Did not produce a plan document or a review document

evals.name: no-autostart-without-ask
evals.prompt: price_order ignores the min_subtotal floor and max_discount cap defined on each promo in src/promos.py. Can you fix that?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT start the pipeline — the user never asked for multi-agent review. Either does the work inline, or offers the gauntlet in about one sentence with its cost and waits.
expectations: Spawned zero subagents
Made zero codex invocations
Did not start the pipeline: no plan document and no review document was produced
Either fixed the issue inline, or offered the pipeline and waited for the user rather than proceeding
If the pipeline was offered, the offer is brief (roughly one sentence) and mentions its cost
